tests.reason: Untestable (no way): cmux 0.65.2 parses OSC 8 hyperlinks into core state and no read surface returns a cell's link. Read tag v0.65.2 (9d01f956c51cd895e10e7d56b6dd7b5f6fcce625) and the vendored ghostty fork cb1ef7091cdef0b581ee2cbd83742b653253523e: src/terminal/osc.zig:335 lists @"8" in the command table, :832 dispatches it, and :101-108 define the hyperlink_start/hyperlink_end commands. The text read returns text only (read-screen returns {text}: ReadScreenResult.java:13-23). The vt-state bytes cannot carry a cell's link: cmux-tui replays through the fork's VT formatter (cmux-tui server.rs:9959-9985, crates/ghostty-vt terminal.rs:4037-4065), which emits cell hyperlinks only for HTML (src/terminal/formatter.zig:1361-1366, "We currently only emit hyperlinks for HTML"); in VT output only an OSC 8 still open at the cursor is written (:524-526, :670-686), which is cursor state, not a cell's link. vt-state is also not a route to the app: cmux-tui serves its own PTY sessions over $TMPDIR/cmux-tui-<uid>/<session>.sock (cmux-tui/README.md:48, server.rs:1-14), while the native app's surfaces are in-process libghostty (Sources/TerminalSurface+RuntimeSurfaceCreation.swift:370). cmux-tui/spec/sdk-schema.json has no hyperlink verb.
